facts.fact: 叙述者（Ms. Opal 的学生/搭档）陷进 Third Layer 的流沙，用 Ms. Opal 教的“雪天使”姿势摊开身体减缓下沉
facts.anchor: I fall backward, spreading my arms out like I’m making a snow angel

facts.fact: Flint（队友）用 falchion 割开 worm fiend 的喉咙，再以剑柄重击并把它踢下悬崖
facts.anchor: Flint slashes the worm fiend across the throat with his falchion.

facts.fact: Jade（搭档）掷出 throwing knife 射进咬住叙述者手臂的 fly fiend 脖子，救下他
facts.anchor: A tiny blade zings through the air.

facts.fact: 叙述者用 knife 刺穿铠甲 fiend 肩颈间的软组织，杀死疑似父亲的怪物
facts.anchor: I plunge the blade into the soft tissue beside his neck

facts.fact: Ten fiends 从前方逼近，at least ten more 从后方包夹，三人被困
facts.anchor: Ten fiends scurry toward us from the front; I turn around, at least ten more

facts.fact: Cadaver Giant 追着 fiend 从三人藏身的蘑菇旁冲过
facts.anchor: The Giant charges past us, chasing the fiends.

facts.fact: Jade 把胃里的东西吐在石头上，巨人的鼻子嗅到后转身锁定三人
facts.anchor: followed by the splatter of vomit on stone.

facts.fact: Flint 先头朝下一跃潜入无底水池，Jade 随后，叙述者最后跳入
facts.anchor: Flint takes a deep inhale, then dives headfirst into the water.
